claim: ATT&CK v19.1 has 15 tactics (the attack graph's nodes).
quote: Enterprise: 15 Tactics, 222 Techniques, 475 Sub-Techniques, 174 Groups, 821 Pieces of Software, 56 Campaigns
issue: The page counts the v19 release. Its version table lists "v19.0 on MITRE/CTIv19.1 on MITRE/CTI" under ATT&CK v19, so v19.1 is a minor release within v19. The v19.1 STIX bundle in the repo (data/gap/_attack/enterprise-attack-19.1.json) has exactly 15 x-mitre-tactic objects, so the number holds for v19.1. "38 attack flows" is our own count and is not checked against this source.

claim: "ATT&CK group is the group page read", cited to mitre2026attackv19.
quote: The April 2026 (v19) ATT&CK release updates Techniques, Groups, Campaigns and Software for Enterprise, Mobile, and ICS.
issue: mitre2026attackv19 is the April 2026 release-notes page. It holds no group pages. The group pages (G0034, G0102 and the rest) are knowledge-base entries, which is mitre2026attackkb. The bib comment says the same: "mitre2026attackv19 above stays the anchor for version-specific claims".
fix_text: "the group page read \citep{mitre2026attackv19}" -> "the group page read \citep{mitre2026attackkb}"

claim: Figure fig:attack-matrix title: "MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise: 15 tactics, 254 techniques".
quote: Enterprise: 15 Tactics, 222 Techniques, 475 Sub-Techniques, 174 Groups, 821 Pieces of Software, 56 Campaigns
issue: Wrong number. v19 Enterprise has 222 techniques; the v19.1 bundle agrees (222 techniques, 475 sub-techniques). 254 is the sum of the figure's column counts (12+9+11+20+22+13+30+18+17+34+9+17+18+9+15), and that counts a multi-tactic technique, such as Valid Accounts in four tactics, once per tactic. The per-column counts themselves match the v19.1 bundle exactly. An uncited neighbour of U0167, whose caption cites mitre2026attackkb.
